I lead the [Behavioral Neuroendocrinology Lab](https://www.sv.uio.no/psi/english/research/groups/bnl/), which investigates the biological systems that link psychological and social factors to health, with a focus on neuroendocrine systems and the autonomic nervous system. Below is a list of my publications, preprints and research materials are linked where available; [email me](mailto:daniel.quintana@psykologi.uio.no) if anything is behind a paywall.
